title: Remove Admin Special Password and Access Code from signup

requirements.text: Remove the "Admin Special Password" / "Access Code" field and all related UI copy from the signup completion form, so users can complete signup after selecting a role without entering any extra code.

quotes: Remove " Admin special Password" and "Access code"

acceptanceCriteria: On the "Complete Your Signup" screen, selecting Admin or Engineer does not reveal any additional code input field.
No user-facing text mentions "Admin Special Password", "special password", or "Access Code" during signup.
Signup can be submitted successfully for both Admin and Engineer roles without entering any code.

requirements.text: Remove frontend validation and error messaging logic that enforces or references the admin/engineer code requirement (including the 6-digit code validation and any translated backend error messages specific to invalid/missing codes).

quotes: Remove " Admin special Password" and "Access code"

acceptanceCriteria: The signup form no longer calls any access-code validation (e.g., no validation errors requiring a 6-digit code).
The signup error translation utility no longer returns messages prompting for an admin/access code or indicating an invalid admin/access code.
No unused access-code validation helpers remain referenced by the signup form.

requirements.text: Update the backend signup flow to eliminate the Admin/Engineer secret code checks, so signupWithRole no longer traps for missing/invalid adminCode and does not compare against any hardcoded code values.

quotes: Remove " Admin special Password" and "Access code"

acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo no longer traps with messages about "Admin role requires a secret code", "Engineer role requires authorization", "Invalid Admin Code", or "Invalid Access Code" during signup.
backend/main.mo no longer contains hardcoded access-code values (e.g., "646151") for signup authorization.
Calling signupWithRole with adminCode = null succeeds for both requestedRole = #admin and requestedRole = #engineer (assuming the caller does not already have a profile).

requirements.text: Update the frontend signup mutation call to stop sending any access code value during signup (send null/omit according to the generated candid bindings), consistent with removing the access-code UI.

quotes: Remove " Admin special Password" and "Access code"

acceptanceCriteria: The signup mutation no longer reads from an access-code input state variable.
The request to signupWithRole does not include any user-entered code value.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything in frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Backend must remain single-actor with all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if required for an upgrade (this change should not require a state migration).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Removing Internet Identity login/sign-in requirements or the broader authorization system (this request is only to remove the admin/access code mechanisms).
Changing role concepts (Admin vs Engineer) beyond removing the secret-code gate.
Adding new authentication providers or password-based authentication.
